faq.a: Enver is associated with the Arabic form أَنْوَر, whose core sense is enver; most luminous (turkish form).

faq.q: What is the origin of Enver?
faq.a: Enver is associated with Arabic. Enver is the Turkish form of Arabic أَنْوَر (Anwar), the elative of نَيِّر, meaning 'most luminous'.
Yes — the underlying form أَنْوَر is Arabic.
Enver can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Enver should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. The root ن و ر is Quranic (light), but Anwar is not itself a Quranic personal name.

faq.q: What does Enver mean in Urdu?

faq.q: What does Enver mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Enver is rendered انور and carries the sense انور، نورانی‌ترین.
A romanized syllable approximation is en-ver. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.q: What are the variants of Enver?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Enver, enver. Script forms are أَنْوَر, انور, अनवर.

faq.q: Is Enver a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as male. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
